Q4 status

The fourth quarter started on schedule and the team shipped the first two milestones before the end of the month. Customer feedback on the new onboarding flow was positive, and support tickets dropped by a third compared with the previous quarter.

Budget stays within the approved range, although the hiring plan moved by two weeks. The steering group will review the remaining scope on the first Monday of November and decide which features move into the next planning cycle.
